# Brain views

> Shows a Workspace member what the Brain knows about one thing, where one statement comes from, or where one process instance stands, each as a bounded view with one starting point.

## Purpose

### Responsible for

| Id | Aliases | Statement | Code |
|---|---|---|---|
| `L2-PLATFORM-BRAIN-VIEWS/R-1` | `RESP-01` | Shows one thing, one statement's evidence, or one process instance as a bounded view. | `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/brain_views` |
| `L2-PLATFORM-BRAIN-VIEWS/R-2` |  | The dossier (PMVP-30a): one thing's name and kind, its facts - each with the document its source passage is in, or the mark «ohne Beleg» - and its documents, read as the person signed in, behind the switch brain_views.enabled; and opening one of those documents, checked with the Core per click, the way a search hit opens. | `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/brain_views/dossier.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/brain_views_routes.py`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/templates/dossier.html`; `KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/src/web_interface/static/css/brain_views.css` |

### Not responsible for

- The modellers' views of the Platform: Ansichten (Graph, Ablauf, Baum, Board, Liste, Matrix, Definitionen, Dokumentation, Lücken), Cortex and the custom views. They read the tenant's whole edge list (graph_views/topology.py) and stay outside this card (graph_views/, views_routes.py, ontology_graph.py, custom_views/).
- A whole-graph screen for members; a member reaches a view from a result, an answer or a name typed into the box (B-02, B-05).
- The links from names in search results and answers to the dossier; the search page (the web app) and the assistant draw them (PMVP-33).
- Who may read a node, a fact or a document: the Core decides, and answers 404 for what the person may not see (graph_api.py, document_readable). Serving a document's file: the web app's file routes and their gate (app.py, document_grants.py); the dossier hands them the one document a person clicks, after the Core's check, through the web app's grant, as the search page does with its rows.
- How a document opens: the search's own enrichment and settings (app.py: \_enhance_listing_rows, pdf_inline_in_browser, \_download_open_enabled) and the file routes; the dossier picks among them in the order a search hit does. What an experiment document is: the Experimente module's split (experiments/search.py), which the dossier calls.
- The switch's place on the settings page and its storage (platform_settings.py, settings_routes.py); this card holds what the one registry entry means.

### Terms

- dossier (the page for one thing - what the Brain knows about it)
- Beleg-Spur (evidence trail - the way from a statement to its passage and document)
- process line (one process instance - its main path, the current step and what is missing)
- ohne Beleg (the mark of a fact that has no source passage the person can open from the dossier)

- The mark-up and the class names of the dossier; the page is built from the shared page parts.

## To review

| At | Why |
|---|---|
| `/owner` | Proposed owner, as for every card in this repository; one role per component is confirmed by a person (Software Map K4). |
| `/status` | Live or planned is not read from the code: the dossier (PMVP-30a) is built on the Platform MVP's branch, behind a switch that is off by default, and not on main yet. |
| `/source_paths` | The plan builds the views as a new module, src/brain_views/ (§ 5.2); PMVP-30a added the dossier (brain_views/dossier.py, its route file, its template and its stylesheet). The existing views the plan's state table lists under "Brain views" (Ansichten, Cortex, custom views) are left out: they read the tenant's whole edge list once per person (graph_views/topology.py) and have no 25-node limit (plan § 3), so they could not keep P-1 and P-3. If PMVP-32 takes the plan's cut (2) - the process line becomes the existing Ablauf view (graph_views/process_views.py and its page) in the new look - that code joins this card or gets one of its own; the coordinator decides then. The wiring (one register_blueprint call in app.py) and the switch's registry entry (platform_settings.py) stay in files no card holds. |
| `/operations` | The three the code reader shows. create_brain_views_blueprint has no line: the plan's contract deltas (section 7) give none, and its one caller is the web app's wiring. PMVP-30b to PMVP-34 add theirs. |
| `/uses` | Declared, as the code reader does not follow the client's methods to the routes they call. /secured/document_readable is on no operation of EXT-BRAIN-API yet (FU-15). Used from the web app as well, which has no card: the file routes (document_external_open, preview_document, download_document), the grant (\_grant_for_current_user), the search's enrichment of a row (\_enhance_listing_rows) and its open settings (pdf_inline_in_browser, \_download_open_enabled), and the Experimente module's split (experiments_search.split). |
| `L2-PLATFORM-BRAIN-VIEWS/*/P-2` | Does not hold yet, so it has no evidence: a fact's source is the Core's provenance_pointer (the document), provenance_chunk_id (the passage) and provenance_status, and no per-thing route returns a passage's text or its page. What holds is http.GET.dossier.\_node_id/P-4: a fact without a mark opens its source document. Follow-up FU-38; the Core request CR-2 (docs/platform-mvp/core-requests.md, one chunk read by its id) would close it. A fact whose document the Core did not list among the node's documents for this person is marked «ohne Beleg» even when it has a passage: the Core shows a fact when any one of its evidence chunks is readable (graph_access.visible_fact_ids), so its provenance document is not known to be readable. |
| `L2-PLATFORM-BRAIN-VIEWS/*/P-3` | The evidence covers the dossier (PMVP-30a); PMVP-30b to PMVP-32 bring theirs. The whole-graph export answers an error for the Knovas tenant (inbox IN-2026-11-10-03, plan § 3). |
